reviewerStatement: Codex performed this review at the creator's explicit request: Do it for me. The delegated_ai authority value and reviewer ID identify Codex as the actual AI judge. This is not personal human inspection or independent human ground truth. I evaluated all 20 displayed requests and all 230 pooled pairs against the visible RGB evidence and exact metric summaries. I inspected every overview candidate and all twelve views for 44 distinct candidates, plus two enlarged individual views. I had prior conversation exposure to descriptions of some development assets; this is not a blind or held-out review. I did not use filenames, retrieval ranks or generated noun-match judgments as the answer key. Known contradictions were marked irrelevant; plausible matches with unestablished required facts were marked unknown. Measurements were used at supplied scale without assuming resizing. All requests were judged usable as written. This artifact covers relevance only; validator verdicts, creator-run engine verification, benchmark qualification and corpus execution are not approved.
